observations: Photo 0 and 1 show the front of a monocrystalline solar panel with half-cut cells.
The panel surface appears clean with no visible cracks or snail trails.
Photo 2 and 3 show the rear of the panel with a white backsheet and three junction boxes.
A specification label is visible in the center of the backsheet in photo 2, but the text is illegible.
Watermarks for 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all photos.
The photos have a date stamp of 2025/08/07, which is in the future.

claims.evidence: This is a business name in the watermark and text, but no registration or physical address is proven.

risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
An electroluminescence (EL) test or a high-resolution photo of the cells under specific lighting.
A video showing a multimeter reading the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: A clear, readable photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
A video of a multimeter test showing the panel's output in sunlight.
Confirmation of the actual current date to explain the 2025 timestamp.
response.reason: The specification label that determines the brand, model, and wattage is visible but completely unreadable. These details are the primary drivers of value for solar equipment.
